testcase.name: Scenario: Export and restore a custom ribbon command: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:390:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Export and restore a custom ribbon command ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel is initially empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is added with Large and Text unchecked and applied ✔ And the customization is exported to a new XML file ✔ And the command is returned to the available list and the empty panel is applied ✔ When the user imports the exported XML file ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the target list with Large and Text unchecked ✔ And the target has a pending-change marker ✔ And the User Commands panel is not yet visible on the Tools ribbon ✔ When the user clicks "Apply" ✔ Then the User Commands panel appears with a small command icon and no visible label ✔ And the customization dialog remains open without a pending-change marker
